sources.evidence_extract: Retrieved directly from the manufacturer's own site (cjiang.com.cn, plain HTTP; the site's HTTPS certificate is expired) via its FNR-series download link. Confirms manufacturer SZ CJIANG TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD; operating temperature range -40C to +125C including self-heating; FNR4030S external dimension 4.0x4.0x3.0mm. FNR4030S4R7MT row: L=4.7uH +/-20% at 100kHz/1V; DCR max 0.078 ohm; S.R.F min 31 MHz; Isat max 2.90 A (typ 3.20 A); Irms max 2.00 A (typ 2.30 A) -- an exact match on every electrical parameter against the retained mirror's max-design figures. The *3/*4 footnote text defining Isat/Irms was not located on the pages checked, so fact-fnr-rating-definitions is not independently confirmed by this retrieval.

sources.evidence_extract: The exact E packaging suffix is listed. The part is 0805 22 uF +/-20% X5R -55 to +85 C, 25 V. The product manual states that Class II capacitance changes with DC voltage and directs designers to evaluate operating-voltage effects; it does not guarantee an exact 3.3 V effective-capacitance value.
